name: deslop-ai
description: Audit and conservatively rewrite vague, formulaic, unsupported, or low-value text in presentations, documents, PDFs, and pasted copy.

interface.longDescription: DeSlopAI audits every eligible text block for meaning, information value, evidence, relevance, and formulaic language, then creates conservative source-faithful revisions with verification evidence.
defaultPrompt: Audit this deck and create a conservative revised copy.
Remove empty buzzwords from this document.
Check whether every bullet adds real information.
